summary.text: A vast sea of blood under Longevity Heaven, revealed when the ground cracks open during a late struggle there.

claims.text: Scarlet waves surge upward as Bing Sai Chuan and the other immortals watch Longevity Heaven split, and a huge Blood Sea appears below.
When Longevity Heaven’s ground cracks open, scarlet red light soars upward and a vast sea of blood appears below.

At the bottom it rumbles with huge waves, and a huge whirlpool sits at its center. Under Longevity Heaven’s luck path dao marks, golden light dyes every droplet of blood water. After waves fill the central whirlpool, the sea turns clear as a mirror, and a huge lump of light rises from it like a miniature sun.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s gaze reaches the Blood Sea at the bottom of Longevity Heaven. It rumbles with huge waves, and a huge whirlpool sits at its center. This Blood Sea had been hidden in Longevity Heaven all along and was created by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s clone, Blood Sea Ancestor. He wanted to create a blood path secluded domain of heaven and earth.

Blood Sea Ancestor left countless blood path inheritances, including nine true inheritances. He left the deepest profundities in Longevity Heaven, and Blood Sea was one of them. Narration states that the sea was small and of low quality at first, reaching an impressive level after countless years of nurturing. Before Giant Sun Immortal Venerable revived, he had already started making arrangements for Blood Sea. The sea is very important to him in that stretch, so he leaves Yao Huang, the subordinate with the best Gu refinement ability, to control the overall situation there.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable activates the immortal killer move Destined Birth Through Luck. By combining that luck path method with Blood Sea, he can revive Gu Immortals. Under Longevity Heaven’s luck path dao marks, golden light dyes every droplet of blood water. Yao Huang states that Blood Sea has the power to revive people on its own, and that with Destined Birth Through Luck the Gu Immortal who revives first will be of great help to Longevity Heaven. After the waves fill the central whirlpool, the sea turns clear as a mirror, and a huge lump of light rises from it like a miniature sun as the first revival completes.
